fields.quoted_span: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.
fields.note: D080 supports the 1.6% rate, the multiply-by-.016 method with the $2,000 example, and the 1.4% rate for 2025-26. It does not mention the 1.7% rate for 2024-25, the exemptions, the capital improvement imputed interest rates, or the uncompensated labor rate.
